description: This file contains unit tests for the UriForLocationHeaderSupplier class, testing its behavior in generating URIs based on HTTP requests and command responses in different scenarios.

classes.name: UriForLocationHeaderSupplierTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing URI generation logic in UriForLocationHeaderSupplier.

methods.name: getUriForIdempotentRequest
methods.description: Tests URI generation for idempotent HTTP requests (PUT method).

methods.name: getUriForIdempotentRequestWithQueryParam
methods.description: Tests URI generation for idempotent requests with query parameters.

methods.name: checkUriForIdempotentRequest
methods.description: Helper method to verify that the URI produced matches the expected URI.

methods.name: getUriForNonIdempotentRequestWithoutEntityIdInUri
methods.description: Tests URI generation for non-idempotent POST requests without entity ID in URI.

methods.name: checkUriForNonIdempotentRequestWithoutEntityIdInUri
methods.description: Helper method to compare expected and actual URIs for non-idempotent requests.

methods.name: getUriForNonIdempotentRequestWithEndingSlash
methods.description: Tests URI generation for non-idempotent POST requests with resource path ending with a slash.

methods.name: getUriForNonIdempotentRequestWithEntityIdInUri
methods.description: Tests URI generation where entity ID is already present in the URI.
